checkpoints.description: [1/4] Redact the AI brief, scope AI patches to lines the stage added, and correct the commit-state docs Reforge flagged

impact_assessment.why: Reforge run-1 on AIKit reported that its own AI review sends unredacted diffs to a free external model, that a patch may rewrite any line of a changed file, and that the README claims .aikit/reforge.json is staged although AIKit ignores it
impact_assessment.benefits: No credential-shaped text leaves the machine, a model cannot edit outside the reviewed hunk, and the documented commit behaviour matches the ignore rule
impact_assessment.risks: contract: build_brief scrubs diffs, findings_from_payload gains a touched-lines check; dependency: standard library plus the existing scrubber; concurrency: unchanged per-project lock; state: the ai report gains a redacted count
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep scrubbing additive, default the new scope check to the real stage, test both, and rerun every gate

checkpoints.description: [4/4] AI brief redacted with the project's secret scanner, AI patches must overlap the stage's added lines, README separates committed project state from AIKit's ignored .aikit/; the fourth finding is a rejected false positive; 607 unit + 69 integration tests and every gate pass; ADR-255; checklists: passed

[4/4] Reforge run-1..run-6 findings triaged: AI brief redacted fail-closed, patches scoped to stage lines, evidence verified against the current file, omitted files declared unknown; stale/removed-line findings rejected; 609 unit + 69 integration tests and every gate pass; ADR-255..258; checklists: passed
